tasks.title: Serve private subscription forms with bounded admission and deterministic release timing
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, entire public flow, all checks and Completion evidence; R2, R6, R7 status and Token exception, R8 status (L0/L7/L8/L9 and precedence), D22, R9, R10; Counterexamples: Status routes, Admission (L9), partial bodies, No enumeration, Response timing, Root hosting, Visitor notice and contact; Acceptance evidence 2, 5-8, 11, 13. One cohesive task keeps form rendering, origin authorization, notify mapping, admission and release scheduling consistent. Reserve SUBSCRIBE_MAX_ADMITTED=256 slots synchronously after origin and before any await/body read; free each exactly once on res.close. Implement SUBSCRIBE_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS=5000, SUBSCRIBE_RELEASE_MS=2000 and SUBSCRIBE_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=1500 on the injected scheduler. Pin the merged contract full SHA; update the complete browser contract-module graph. Record any wire gap as a shared finding. R2 Release and R8 Timing distinguish registrations (including cancelled timers) from live timers: full registration lists [5000, 2000, 1500] or [5000, 2000] at L0, with at most 2 live timers per request; release is first only after the address passes.

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; focused coverage is not the gate. Real HTTP on port 0 covers every Status routes counterexample and literal code/call count: 403 origin, 415 type, 413 at 2049 bytes, 400 fields/address/token, 405 other methods, GET/HEAD links cause 0 notify calls. POSTs send the exact contract bodies and bearer header. Redirects are not followed (second server 0 calls), absent wire header is tolerated and wire 2 fails. Valid link tokens appear exactly once in escaped hidden fields of 200 GET/HEAD pages only; invalid links and every POST result contain neither token nor visitor address. Result pages are no-store/no-referrer with form-action 'self'. Full L0 and L9 do not limit confirm or unsubscribe. Feature off preserves the existing page, 404/405 and form-action 'none', with 0 scheduling calls or admission state. Contract browser import-graph test passes.

0 failing tests; focused coverage is not the gate. Every status No enumeration row (L0, L8, L9 full/one below and all nine notify outcomes) uses fresh fixtures and both orders; status, every header except date and body are byte-equal. L9 full uses 128 answers waiting for release plus 128 partial bodies (256 admitted); one below uses 128 waiting answers plus 127 partial bodies (255). Both valid and invalid bodies get the same 503 busy page when full, with 0 notify calls; one below follows the release path. Literal Check your inbox text includes 24 hours and contact, with no Location, Retry-After, Set-Cookie or ETag. Answers never echo a visitor address, token or forged host.

0 failing tests; focused coverage is not the gate. All D22 checks 1-4 run through raw sockets, a manual clock and recording scheduler for confirmed K, pending P and unknown U, in K/P/U and U/P/K orders with fresh fixtures, below every limit, at L0 and one below L9. Exact timer registration order is [5000, 2000, 1500] when calling notify and [5000, 2000] when L0 skips it. Registrations include cancelled timers; after each registration assert at most literal 2 live timers (registered, neither fired nor cancelled). The 5000 body timer is cancelled before release registration; the 2000 release is registered at address-pass t0 and before the 1500 requestJson timer and notify call. Fast/delayed 202, 503, 302, bad body, closed socket, network/version errors and no answer all produce 0 response bytes before release, including after the 1500 call timeout fires; only the 2000 release writes the whole byte-equal answer. Firing release with call still open aborts its signal, frees its call slot and cancels its timeout; disconnect cancels release and aborts the call. Before-address refusals register 0 timers for 403/415/L9 full, and exactly [5000], cancelled, for 413/400 fields/400 address; none registers release or call timers. Test-written early-answer handler fails check 2; test-written requestJson timeoutMs:2000 handler records [5000, 2000, 2000] and fails check 1. Timer values are literals independent of source constants. SMTP/fan-out completion is never a timing barrier.

0 failing tests; focused coverage is not the gate. Every Admission (L9), partial bodies counterexample uses the specified real server/request-listener observation, raw sockets, frozen manual scheduler and held notify. Open 257 partial bodies concurrently: exactly 256 admitted and 1 synchronous 503, 0 bytes to admitted sockets, 0 notify calls, exactly 256 timers of 5000 ms and 0 of 2000 ms. Complete the 256 bodies: all 256 body timers cancelled, exactly 256 release timers of 2000 ms, 8 call timers of 1500 ms and 8 notify calls; request 258 gets 503. Each of eight paths runs with 255 other admitted requests and frees exactly 1 slot: 400 address, 413, 400 fields, disconnect during body, disconnect before release, 5000 body deadline, 2000 release, 415. After its response close, probe admits 1 and refuses the next with 503. Body deadline destroys request with 0 response bytes; content-length >2048 cancels its body timer; 415 registers none. Admission precedes content-type and body validation, so a full cap returns 503 even for text/plain or invalid address, while bad origin still returns 403. All response-close outcomes, including 500/body-read error, free once via guarded res.once(close), never on both finish/release and close. Closing all sockets restores 256 admissions and 1 refusal. Confirm/unsubscribe remain 200 at full L0/L9 and do not alter admission count. Test-written check-before-body/count-after-body handler records 257 admitted/release timers, proving the regression check can fail.

0 failing tests. R10 notice contains every literal sentence with 25-hour deletion, 24-hour confirmation, immediate queue deletion, the one in-flight email, sent-mail/backups exception and contact. Notice appears between input and button, referenced by aria-describedby, also on invalid-address pages. Email contact normalizes, HTTPS contact escapes correctly; missing/invalid contact, missing public URL or token and a 31-character token fail without echoing values. R9 accepts root with/without trailing slash, rejects /pulse and /pulse/ with exit 2 and the literal R9 line before files/listeners; the existing prefix-with-feature-off test stays green.

acceptance.command: bun run check && bun run check:a11y
acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, typecheck, full suite with at least 80% line coverage (including src/subscribe-test-support.ts) and axe pass. e2e/run.ts checks the form/notice and five result pages at 360/1280 px, light/dark, JavaScript on/off, with 0 violations and keyboard-accessible labelled controls.

Manual acceptance with configured root origin, test token/contact and a tiny local fake notify: submit the form, open the confirmation link and press its button; record commands, literal status codes and the approximately 2 s subscribe answer. No-JavaScript flow works. Root form actions and configured-origin checks ignore forged Host/X-Forwarded headers. Include the run in the PR.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; repeat on the starting main in a separate checkout; PR gives both CPU medians and B minus A, within api/bench/budgets.json status test budget 3.4 s (expected increase at most 0.5 s). Measure runtime with the Performance impact --b-ref command when api main supports it, or document its absence and why off-by-default runtime metrics should not change.

exit 0; PR includes full check/a11y logs, merged contract SHA, manual run and performance evidence, and the applicable Security impact checklist: origin before synchronous admission, bounded bodies/calls/admissions, 5000 ms body deadline and its cancellation, single response-close slot release, distinct 1500 ms call timeout and 2000 ms release, timed membership-free answers, Token exception, safe contact escaping, configured URLs/no redirects and no personal data in logs or release closures. Docs include the R9 root requirement, R10 operator duties and all status known limits named in its section, including D-R12's 256 slots covering body reading for at most 5 s plus release waiting for 2 s.
